title: Build a Mini Theme
prompt:
Create a small theme with custom properties:

- On `:root`, declare `--brand` (any color) and `--space` (a rem value).
- Style `.button` using `var(--brand)` as its background-color and `var(--space)` as its padding.
- Style `p` with a `font-size` in `rem` (no px).
boilerplate: Modern type scales with the reader.

tests.name: custom properties declared on :root
button uses both variables
tests.hint: var(--name) reads a custom property — .button { background-color: var(--brand); padding: var(--space); }

tests.name: rem font size
tests.hint: font-size: 1rem; — rem scales with the reader's settings, px does not.
